_help: Thrown projectiles by type_id (Skillz, DESIGN §22 / MAIN_HOOKS §22). Spawned only through ThrownProjectile.spawn(spec) with spec = {type_id, variant, rarity, pos, vel, owner_id, seed} (Netz co-op contract; grenades will reuse it). Motion: ballistic, gravity m/s^2 (its own, not the world's: a slow, readable lob). launch_speed = horizontal speed in m/s, so flight time = range / launch_speed. collision_radius m: what touches the world and players; visual_radius m: the drawn glob. direct_damage: HP on a direct hit when the owner has no projectile_damage(type_id) (the Gallspitter scales it from its wave damage, zombies.json gallspitter.behavior.glob_damage_mult). lifetime s, then it pops where it is. impact.hazard: a ground hazard spawned where it lands (radius m, duration s, dps HP/s while inside, ticked every tick s; slow = player move speed -x, strongest slow wins; one gall puddle at a time damages a player). visual.model: Desi's GLB by path (placeholder sphere if missing); puddle_model_radius = the radius the puddle GLB is authored at (scaled to impact.radius); visual.color / emission: the placeholder. variants: per-variant overrides (none yet, grenades will add some). Grenades (playtest #25): type 'grenade' has body 'grenade' (spawn() makes the Grenade RigidBody; numbers live in data/grenades.json by variant), variants = every grenades.json variant id. Child types: 'grenade_bomblet' (Rookery; fuse s then pops, settles on landing; the host blasts in its impacted handler, impact.vfx_blast = puppets draw the blast) and 'heal_orb' (Leechbell; homing: no gravity / world collision, home_speed m/s, arrive_radius m, impacted(direct_hit = owner) on arrival, the host heals; audio.arrive = 2D chime for the local player; loop_cap = max orbs humming).
